effect:
When held by a Pokémon, it receives 50% of experience from battles even if it doesn't participate. Invaluable for training low-level Pokémon or balancing your team's levels.

Given by Elm's aide in the Azalea/Ilex Forest gate. Can also be purchased from the Indigo Plateau Mart.
